author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Before, the hand was an L-shaped hook plus a box stub that read as an arrow or plug, so no pointing finger was visible. Now a Lucide-pointer style hand (index finger up with a round tip, knuckle bump, thumb, open wrist) stands under the rounded projected-panel arch, and the projector base line carries a lens bump, as in the reference.
omissions: Extra knuckle bumps (one kept) and the projector's pill body (reduced to a base line with a lens bump, to keep 8-unit spacing below the hand).
